title: selaginella patula var. cordifolia
intro: Selaginella patula var. cordifolia, commonly known as Spurwort or Heart-leaf Spurwort, is a species of spore-producing plant in the Selaginellaceae family, a type of evergreen, perennial, and non-flowering plant also known as resurrection plants due to their ability to survive extreme conditions. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella patula var. cordifolia include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, with potential applications in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential health benefits.
